name: rut-demo
description: rut language playground — React + rspack + TypeScript; runs rut as wasm (RFC 0041 §3)

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p rut-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs
scripts.smoke: node scripts/preflight-wasm.mjs && npm run build:smoke && node scripts/smoke.mjs
